project: TinyQV - RISC-V SoC with HDMI output
details: This version of TinyQV uses the new 3v3 standard cell library, 3v3 SRAM macros and the split voltage pads.  Apart from that it is similar to the Run 1 TinyQV, but with additional scratch RAM, new HDMI/VGA text mode output support and a single 8-bit DAC.
